text:
Hi there, and thanks so much for contacting Leafy! 🌿

The **Collector** plan for Plant Club is **$49/month**. Here's what you get:

- One surprise plant each month, matched to your light level
- A medium or rare plant in a 6-inch pot
- The normal Plant Care Guarantee on every plant

A few helpful timing details:

- You're charged on the **25th** of the previous month.
- Boxes ship in the **first full week** of the month.
- You can list up to 3 plants you already own so you don't get duplicates.

There's also no cancellation fee or minimum term, so you can skip, pause (up to 3 months), change plan or cancel any time from "Account" > "Subscriptions".

If you have any other questions about Plant Club, I'm happy to help. Happy planting! 🪴
